name: worktree-data-sync
description: Sync non-git data between existing git worktrees

interface.shortDescription: Compare and sync non-git worktree data.
interface.longDescription: Seed, diff, and apply changes for managed non-git files across existing worktrees without touching git branches or worktree creation.
defaultPrompt: Use Worktree Data Sync to compare non-git data between these two worktrees.
